result.finding: JDBC over TCP (port 1433) is the only communication protocol - used to connect to Azure SQL Database
evidence: No @RestController, @RequestMapping, HttpClient, or RestTemplate usage found
No message queue dependencies (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.) in pom.xml
MainSQL.java uses SQLServerDataSource with JDBC URL: jdbc:sqlserver://*.database.windows.net:1433
Connection uses ActiveDirectoryMSI authentication over encrypted TLS (encrypt=true)
values: Security: TLS encrypted, Managed Identity authentication (ActiveDirectoryMSI)
